versions.name: RXV2-0.9.427-steady-front
versions.notes: No more front-screen shuffle: the app remembers the last known layout (Fly now hidden? Rotorflight present, and which version?) and paints it instantly at launch, before the receiver has even answered. The live state then only repaints if something actually changed - so on a Rotorflight model the right buttons are simply there from the first frame.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.426-rescue-plain
versions.notes: 'Rescue switch' is now simply 'Rescue', for the same reason as Arming: it is a channel, and what drives it is the radio's business.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.425-arming-plain
versions.notes: 'Arming switch' is now simply 'Arming' - it is a channel, not necessarily a switch: some radios drive it from a safety switch or mix among other functions. (Malcolm's precision, gladly accepted.)

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.424-strict-channels
versions.notes: Strictly one channel per function now: taken channels vanish from every other dropdown (no sharing at all), existing double-bookings are repaired on load (the later claimant resets to 'Choose...', keeping its name), and the stick labels lose their bracketed words - just Aileron, Elevator, Collective, Rudder, Throttle.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.423-no-collisions
versions.notes: Two field-driven fixes on Transmitter channels: (1) taken channels are simply not offered in the other dropdowns any more (switch functions may still share with each other - only sticks and Arm are exclusive); (2) the Rescue switch can be removed entirely (X sets None and clears any saved rescue from the flight controller - some models just don't have one), and saving with Rescue=None also wipes a stale saved rescue.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.422-erasable
versions.notes: Added functions can now be deleted cleanly: the X on each row (after a confirm) removes it AND clears its switch range from the flight controller if it had been saved - experiments and mistakes leave no trace. Only the exact function-on-that-switch is cleared; everything else is untouched.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.421-settled-rows
versions.notes: Added functions now settle in: name one (e.g. 'Sally'), hit return, and the row collapses to look exactly like the fixed rows above - name on the left, channel, live value, Detect. Tap the name to edit it again. New rows open in editing form with the keyboard ready.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.420-named-switches
versions.notes: Added functions on Transmitter channels are now tidy stacked cards that fit the phone screen (the old row overflowed sideways), and each can be given YOUR OWN NAME - a User switch might really be 'Lower undercarriage'. The name lives in the app; the flight controller sees the function.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.419-esc-words
versions.notes: Clearer ESC wording after Malcolm went looking for Scorpion under ESC signal: the SIGNAL row now says heli ESCs (Scorpion, Kontronik, YGE, Hobbywing) use Normal PWM and DShot is for drone-style ESCs; the TELEMETRY row now says that is where the brand goes.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.418-complete-menu
versions.notes: A la carte is now the COMPLETE catalogue: Transmitter channels and First-time basics appear there too, so everything the wizards walk through can also be reached on its own. The Wizards menu stays clean with just the two guides.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.417-more-functions
versions.notes: Transmitter channels grows 'Add another function' - black box, beeper, self-level, governor overrides, user switches and more, each detectable by wiggle and written as a verified switch range. Two functions may share one switch; sticks and Arm may never be shared. The Wizards menu is now just the two guides - Transmitter channels and First-time basics live inside the New-helicopter wizard as its steps 3 and 4.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.416-wizard-steps
versions.notes: Transmitter channels and First-time basics moved to the Wizards page where they belong - they are the build wizard's two big steps, listed there for a straight jump. A la carte now holds only the individual tuning/setup pages.
